entry.title: 2023-q1
entry.summary: The image viewer has a new regions-of-interest menu, with automatic difference detection that is faster and offers several diff metrics. Text diffs can jump from one change to the next, and the backend moved to Python 3.11.
entry.content:
The image viewer has a new regions-of-interest menu, with automatic difference detection that is faster and offers several diff metrics. Text diffs can jump from one change to the next, and the backend moved to Python 3.11.

Users

New regions-of-interest viewer

A "View ROIs" menu in the image viewer switches between the full image, the ROI presets from your input metadata, and automatically detected differences with the reference. It always offers the full image and keeps a stable layout.

Learn more →
Users

Faster automatic diffs, with more metrics

Finding regions of interest is faster and no longer runs out of memory on huge images. You can pick the difference metric (YIQ, SSIM, CIE 1976, CIE 1994 or CIE 2000), and the last one used is remembered.

Users

Navigate text diffs

The text viewer jumps to the first difference with the reference, has a "Next Diff" button, and says when both files have the same content.

Web app​

  • is_failed metrics are now shown, including for failed runs.
  • Wider sections on wide screens, clearer error messages, and no more empty tooltips.

CLI and project setup​

  • Runs now get the batch label as QA_LABEL, and their QA-Board ID as context.id.
  • Configurations can be null.
  • Redoing a run from the web app now reuses the original output directory.

Server and administration​

  • The backend image now uses Python 3.11 on a newer OS.
  • The web app is built with a multi-stage Dockerfile, for faster builds and smaller images. Compose files pick the development or production target.
  • The bundled Cantaloupe image server is no longer started by the default docker compose setup, in favor of an image server running separately.
  • The backend trusts every git repository it clones (safe.directory), avoiding errors with recent git versions.

Fixes​

  • Fixed errors when the reference output was deleted.
  • Fixed "same data" being shown too often in the file viewers.

entry.title: 2022-q4
entry.summary: A quiet quarter: safer output directory names, Jenkins runners configurable from environment variables, a cap on the size of tuning batches, and backend stability tweaks.
entry.content:
A quiet quarter: safer output directory names, Jenkins runners configurable from environment variables, a cap on the size of tuning batches, and backend stability tweaks.

Project integration

Jenkins runner configuration from the environment

The Jenkins runner can now read its build URL and token from QA_RUNNERS_JENKINS_BUILD_URL and QA_RUNNERS_JENKINS_TOKEN, so they don't have to live in qaboard.yaml. The token is now optional.

Learn more →

Web app​

  • Tuning from the web app is now limited to 5000 runs per batch, and the form says so.
  • The CI integrations menu refreshes statuses as soon as it opens, and links to Jenkins builds open the build page.
  • Runs aborted before writing their file manifest now get one when you open them.
  • Logs with stray < characters are now displayed correctly.

CLI and project setup​

  • Output directory names derived from input paths are now always slugified, avoiding characters that cause problems on some filesystems. New runs of inputs with such characters get a different output directory.

Server and administration​

  • The backend recycles its workers after a number of requests, a maximum lifetime or too much memory use, and nginx waits up to 10 minutes for slow API calls.
  • Several API endpoints and webhooks read database rows in chunks to use less memory.
  • Exports to a folder now report when they fail to create symlinks.

entry.title: 2022-q3
entry.summary: You can delete several batches at once and sort runs by storage. Auto-optimizations can resume from a checkpoint, and servers can report crashes to Sentry.
entry.content:
qaboard v1.0.2

You can delete several batches at once and sort runs by storage. Auto-optimizations can resume from a checkpoint, and servers can report crashes to Sentry.

Users

Delete multiple batches

The commit page's batch menu has a new "Delete multiple batches" option to pick and delete several batches in one go. Milestones are skipped.

Users

Resumable auto-optimization

qa optimize has a new --checkpoint option to save its progress and restart interrupted optimizations. Tunings started from the web app use it automatically, and show accurate iteration counts.

Learn more →
Users

Storage per batch

The Output Files view shows the total storage used by the selected runs, and runs can be sorted by storage.

Admins

Crash monitoring with Sentry

The backend and the web app can report errors and performance traces to Sentry. Set SENTRY_DSN (and optionally SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE) on the backend to enable it.

Learn more →

Web app​

  • The image, video and bit-accuracy viewers can now compare raw/hex images by their image metadata and pixel-data hash, when the manifest has them, instead of the file hash.
  • Layout tweaks for small and wide screens.

CLI and project setup​

  • The qaboard package is now version 1.0.2.
  • Auto-optimization: clearer errors when the objective cannot be computed, logs reachable from the web app even when the first iteration fails, and a QA_SEED that now seeds every random generator.
  • qa check-bit-accuracy prints clearer logs, with links to the failing comparisons.
  • Windows paths are now converted case-insensitively and with forward slashes.

Server and administration​

  • Upgraded the Cantaloupe image server from 4.1 to 5.0.
  • PostgreSQL now allows 200 connections, with more working memory per query.
  • The backend has configurable memory limits and UWSGI_CHEAPER_OVERLOAD to tune how quickly workers are spawned.
  • The cleanup job reads commits in chunks, using much less memory on large databases.

Fixes​

  • Fixed crashes when the reference lacks a metric present in the new run.
  • Fixed crashes of the history page and of some project index pages.
  • Fixed the detection of raw and hex image files.
  • Fixed tuning forms that were sometimes disabled for no reason.
